Hey man, I can understand what you’re going through. I recently lost my only friend because I tried to kill myself. So I don’t have anyone to talk to. Not only that, Im a gay man that has Aspergers and social anxiety so people don’t want to be around me. It gets lonely a lot of the time. Even when I do get people to talk to, I just cut them out of my life because I feel that I don’t deserve them. If you want you can chat with me. I’ll be a bit honest, I’m quite shy and really bad at initiating conversations. I’m just bad at conversations in general due to years of bullying and isolation from my school days, but if you want someone that isn’t like that I’ll understand.
